title: Create a copy of this project
description: A new project with the same sections, fields, columns and settings — and no tasks, ready for the next week.
name: Name of the new project
always: Always copied: sections, fields with their options, and the column layout.
shiftHelp: The project dates and the dates inside copied checks and reports move by this many days. Use 7 for the next week, 0 to keep them.
noTasks: Tasks are not copied. Comments, history and personal settings stay with the original.
warningsTitle: Some settings could not be copied. The project works without them:
applyTitle: Copy these settings to other projects
applyDescription: Sums, planning checks (including “fact required before done”) and defaults for new tasks are copied from this project. Fields and sections are matched by name. Tasks are not touched.
applyReplace: Replace settings that already exist in the selected projects
